```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

umd_courses <- read_rds("data/umd_courses.rds")
```

### Which department has the highest mean (average) number of seats for its classes? You need to show the department with the highest average first. Which one is the most surprising/interesting to you?

```{r}
umd_courses |> 
  group_by(department) |> 
  summarise (mean_seats = mean(seats)) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_seats))

```

### Find out the greatest number of times any individual class has been offered in our dataset. You must show the greatest number of classes first.

```{r}

umd_courses |> 
  group_by(id) |> 
  summarise(count = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(count))

```

### Count the number of courses for each instructor and department. Which instructor has taught the most?

```{r}
umd_courses |> 
  group_by(instructors, department) |>
  summarise(count_classes = n()) |> 
  arrange(desc(count_classes))
```
